text: この　わざを　みんなは　だいもんじやき　と　よんでるが　そりゃ　まちがいだ！
note: The move's Japanese name comes from the giant bonfire in the shape of the character 大 lit on a mountainside in Kyoto every August 16; outsiders often call the event Daimonji-yaki, a name Kyoto people dislike. The English game dropped this and put battle advice about Fire Blast instead.
claim: Kyoto lights a giant bonfire shaped like the character 大 on a mountainside every August 16, popularly called Daimonji.

check.quote: Gozan no Okuribi (五山送り火, roughly "The Five Mountainous Send-Off Fires"), more commonly known as Daimonji ... It is the culmination of the Obon festival on August 16
